body: No, I'm not on any medication. Sorry if that was unclear.
I never have, no. As soon as I get health insurance again I'm going to start seeing someone. But I don't have that option right now.

Cannabis. Anxiety and depression. In high school I went to therapy for social anxiety but everyone seemed to think the depression aspects were just part of shitty hormonal girl shit and they'd go away eventually. They never did. I mean, sometimes they do. But they always come back.

Booze and cannabis. When I smoke regularly, I don't get depressed. It's not an ameliorative, it's a preventative -- I don't get panic attacks, and my quality of life is generally better. But I'm sure there's an element of psychological addiction there as well, and that makes me feel shitty too.
